parts:

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] A description of what's happening on Jenkins
parts:
Thanks for documenting this.

Andrew should blog this if people want to see how the sausage
is really made! It's quite startling to me to see this all laid
out end to end with the tests and equipment. We should include
this in our IES grant report, too, as they paid for the x-platform
testbed, which has served us really well.

I don't think we need to encrypt anything.

+1 to better notification --- that "no test results found" thing
is rattling.

For upstream branch control, would that be something along
the lines of "Jenkins, a's upstream branch is b" or some
other invocation? I've never had to deal with this, but we
want to make it easy, especially as we head into the big
refactor.

You can see from the daily performance reports that there
are funny outliers presumably not due to our software changing
but due to hardware/network issues. This we can just deal with
by eye and perhaps rerunning if we're worried.

- Bob

P.S. Favorite piece of equipment: Andrew's broken laptop
